item.description: ### Fixed - **A reply can no longer approve a permission prompt by accident.** If a session was waiting on a permission prompt and you sent it a reply, from your iPhone or from a Mac notification, the agent's dialog ignored your text and took the Enter as "Yes". The command ran whatever you had typed, including "no, don't do that". Perch now refuses to send a reply while a session is waiting on a permission prompt. Use Allow or Deny, or answer at the terminal. Replies to a session that is asking you a question work as before. No iPhone update is needed: updating the Mac is enough.
